claims.object_text: oxidation in aging and 3xTg-AD mouse brains
claims.quote: KCNB1 (formerly Kv2.1), a voltage-gated K(+) channel abundantly expressed in the cortex and hippocampus, is oxidized in the brains of aging mice and of the triple transgenic 3xTg-AD mouse model of Alzheimer's disease.

claims.object_text: oxidation enhances apoptosis in mammalian cell lines
claims.quote: KCNB1 oxidation acts to enhance apoptosis in mammalian cell lines
whereas a KCNB1 variant resistant to oxidative modification, C73A-KCNB1, is cytoprotective.

claims.object_text: oxidized KCNB1 channels form oligomers held together by disulfide bridges involving Cys-73
claims.quote: oxidized KCNB1 channels, which form oligomers held together by disulfide bridges involving Cys-73, accumulated in the plasma membrane as a result of defective endocytosis.

claims.object_text: oxidized KCNB1 channels accumulated in the plasma membrane due to defective endocytosis
claims.quote: oxidized KCNB1 channels, which form oligomers held together by disulfide bridges involving Cys-73, accumulated in the plasma membrane as a result of defective endocytosis.

claims.object_text: C73A-mutant channels do not oligomerize and are normally internalized
claims.quote: In contrast, C73A-mutant channels, which do not oligomerize, were normally internalized.
KCNB1 channels localize in lipid rafts

claims.object_text: cholesterol supplementation reduces apoptosis promoted by KCNB1 oxidation
claims.quote: Accordingly, cholesterol supplementation reduced apoptosis promoted by oxidation of KCNB1.

claims.object_text: accumulation of KCNB1 oligomers disrupts planar lipid raft integrity and causes apoptosis via activating the c-Src/JNK signaling pathway
claims.quote: Together, these data suggest that the accumulation of KCNB1 oligomers in the membrane disrupts planar lipid raft integrity and causes apoptosis via activating the c-Src/JNK signaling pathway.

claims.object_text: inhibition of c-Src and JNK suppresses the pro-apoptotic effect of KCNB1 oxidation
claims.quote: Inhibition of raft-associating c-Src tyrosine kinase and downstream JNK kinase by pharmacological and molecular means suppressed the pro-apoptotic effect of KCNB1 oxidation.
